description: Simplified studio file-service authorization policy (for the demo; redacted and rewritten)

product.intent: Delivery zone: content is a deliverable and must be immutable

work.intent: Work zone: everyone writes only inside their own directory

notes: A non-admin performing modify/delete/chmod/chown in the product zone is a clear policy violation, not a mis-click
The work zone allows 'self_bootstrap': a user may create their own work/<username> directory
Every failure must leave an audit record (who / when / on what / why it failed)
